status: review-only; not wired into the build
policy: Records omitted from this file are deliberate keeps from the source-audited translation.

changes.TT6A/g0/r1: Joseph: Oh… what am I supposed to do now? How can I go on like this? Kashim, enough sleeping. Wake up, Kashim!
changes.TT6A/g0/r4: The sun is out, but the wind makes it chilly.
changes.TT6A/g0/r7: Joseph… Mary… and a child. Wait. That would mean… could it be…?
changes.TT6A/g0/r8: TIME: AROUND 4 BC — PLACE: NAZARETH, ISRAEL — NAME: KASHIM — OCCUPATION: DONKEY
changes.TT6A/g0/r11: Joseph: Kashim, listen to me. Just hear me out, all right?
changes.TT6A/g0/r12: Joseph: You're not even going to listen?
changes.TT6A/g0/r13: Joseph: My fiancée Mary appears to be pregnant. I swear before God, I've never so much as touched her hand! She says she doesn't know how it happened… Can that possibly be true? Me: Hee-haw… Joseph: Nothing makes sense anymore! The engagement is off!
changes.TT6A/g0/r16: Joseph: That bracelet! Did Mary send it?!
changes.TT6A/g0/r17: Don't lie to me! Mary sent it, didn't she?
changes.TT6A/g0/r18: Joseph: I see… She was too ashamed to face me, so she sent you instead. Me: Hee-haw! Joseph: No matter what she says, I still can't believe that story about an angel… Just then… someone descended from above.
changes.TT6A/g0/r19: Joseph: Who are you?! Devil: I am an angel, bearing the voice of God… Me: Brrr! Devil: Joseph… Joseph: Y-yes! Devil: Mary carries God's child. Do not fear. Take her as your wife. Joseph: Yes! Devil: And the child shall be named "Demon." Do you understand? Joseph: Yes, angel! Devil: Excellent.
changes.TT6A/g0/r21: With some unexpected help, the two were finally married. Several months later…
changes.TT6A/g0/r26: Elder: This is terrible… They were so close. There's nothing more I can do.
changes.TT6A/g0/r27: Child: Everyone's down by the river! Tell us the story! Elder: Yes, yes. All right.
changes.TT6A/g0/r28: A small village of white houses.
changes.TT6A/g1/r1: A rope ties me to a post.
changes.TT6A/g1/r2: Ohhh… I really am a donkey…
changes.TT6A/g1/r4: A sweet smell tickles my nose.
changes.TT6A/g1/r5: Elder: There may still be one small chance to bring them back together.
changes.TT6A/g1/r8: I shouldn't be able to eat this… Me: Brr! Brrrr! Weird… but it's good.
changes.TT6A/g1/r10: TIME: AROUND 4 BC — PLACE: NAZARETH — NAME: KASHIM — OCCUPATION: DONKEY
changes.TT6A/g1/r15: Her eyes light up with joy.
changes.TT6A/g1/r17: A hand-cranked mill for grinding wheat.
changes.TT6A/g1/r18: This looks like it's meant for a man…
changes.TT6A/g1/r22: Mary: What is it? Me: Brrrr… Mary: Please, listen to me.
changes.TT6A/g1/r23: Mary: Last night, an angel appeared to me… "You carry God's child. Raise him together with Joseph." But Joseph won't believe me.
changes.TT6A/g1/r25: Mary: I'll wait here until Joseph is willing to see me again.
changes.TT6A/g1/r26: Mary: That necklace! Did Joseph send it?!
changes.TT6A/g1/r27: No! Joseph gave it to you, didn't he?
changes.TT6A/g1/r28: Mary: I see… He was too ashamed to face me, so he sent you. Me: Hee-haw! I was sure he would trust me… She puts on the necklace.
changes.TT6A/g2/r0: Me: Munch… Brr! Mary: Eat as much as you like. Me: Hee-haw!
changes.TT6A/g2/r2: Mary: It's a token I meant to give Joseph at our wedding… Her eyes fill with tears. Mary: I'll wait here until Joseph is ready to see me.
changes.TT6A/g2/r3: Mary: You'll carry it for me? She gently places it in my mouth.
changes.TT6A/g2/r4: Mary: You're such a clever boy!
changes.TT6A/g2/r6: A colorful necklace rests on the shelf.
changes.TT6A/g2/r7: He's attacking the wood with his plane.
changes.TT6A/g2/r8: Plane, saw, hammer… Some tools really haven't changed much.
changes.TT6A/g2/r10: This looks like it's meant for a woman…
changes.TT6A/g2/r11: Wood shavings get up my nose. Me: Mmmph…
changes.TT6A/g2/r12: Joseph: You got yourself untied again…
changes.TT6A/g2/r13: Joseph: She got tired of me and made the whole story up. The pregnancy has to be a lie!
changes.TT6A/g2/r20: Joseph: A wedding gift I meant for Mary… Tears and snot stream down his face. Joseph: Damn it! Damn it!!
changes.TT6A/g2/r23: A group of children has gathered.
changes.TT6A/g2/r26: He seems to be waiting for something.
changes.TT6A/g2/r29: Smoke gets up my nose. Me: Mmmph…
changes.TT6A/g2/r30: Child: Aren't you going to start yet, Grandpa?
changes.TT6A/g2/r31: Elder: Israel's past is a history of wandering, painful wars, and suffering under oppression. Babylon, Greece, Egypt, Rome… the rulers changed, but ordinary people's lives never improved. But do not lose hope. A savior will come!
changes.TT6A/g3/r0: Elder: The ancient scripture says it plainly: "From Bethlehem in Judea, a savior shall arise."
changes.TT6A/g3/r2: I really did become a donkey.
changes.TT6A/g3/r3: Soldier: Are you Joseph? Joseph: Yes. Soldier: Emperor Augustus has ordered a census. Where were you born? Joseph: Bethlehem… Soldier: Then go there at once and register.
